target.rawSql: SELECT actual_start AS time, change_id AS text, ARRAY['deploy', change_type] AS tags FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(actual_start) AND status='implemented'
SELECT created_at AS time, incident_id AS text, ARRAY['P1','major-incident', service] AS tags FROM incidents WHERE priority='P1' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

description: ITSM Executive Dashboard for Enterprise Banking. ITIL v4 KPIs across Incident, Change, CMDB/Asset, Risk and IT Performance. Data source: PostgreSQL (Jira + CMDB replicas).
title: ITSM Executive Dashboard (PostgreSQL)

list.name: service
list.label: Business Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' ORDER BY 1

list.name: assignment_group
list.label: Assignment Group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT assignment_group FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total Incidents (30d)
panels.description: Count of all incident tickets created in the selected time window. Baseline volume KPI: sudden spikes indicate systemic issues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Open Incidents
panels.description: Currently open (not resolved / not closed) incidents. Watch trend — a rising open backlog signals reduced throughput.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed')

panels.title: Major Incidents (P1)
panels.description: P1 incidents created in window. Executive-level KPI — any non-zero value should be reviewed at CAB.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND priority='P1' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: SLA Compliance %
panels.description: Percentage of incidents resolved within their SLA target. Target ≥ 95% (ITIL v4 best practice for Tier-1 banking services).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Overall Health Score
panels.description: Composite service-health index (0-100) blending availability, SLA, error budget, and incident load. > 85 = healthy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(health_score) AS value FROM service_health WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: Operational Risk Score
panels.description: Composite operational risk (0-100) — lower is better. Aggregates capacity, EOL, security, change-failure and vendor risk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(score) AS value FROM risk_scores WHERE env='${env}' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

panels.title: Incident Volume by Priority (30d)
panels.description: Daily incident volume grouped by priority (P1-P4). Reveals surges and recurring peak windows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, priority AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incident Severity Distribution
panels.description: Share of open incidents by priority. Use to spot severity-mix drift (e.g. rising P1/P2 share).

targets.rawSql: SELECT priority AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed') GROUP BY 1

panels.title: SLA Compliance by Business Service
panels.description: Per-service SLA compliance %. Bars below target (95%) are candidates for immediate remediation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service AS metric, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC

panels.title: Incidents by Assignment Group (Open vs Closed)
panels.description: Distribution of tickets by resolver group. Highlights teams with high open counts (potential bottleneck).

targets.rawSql: SELECT assignment_group, SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('resolved','closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('resolved','closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY open DESC

panels.title: Incident Aging Heatmap (Service × Age Bucket)
panels.description: How long open incidents have been alive per service. Concentration in the 7-14d / >14d buckets indicates stale backlog.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service, CASE WHEN age_days < 1 THEN '<1d' WHEN age_days < 3 THEN '1-3d' WHEN age_days < 7 THEN '3-7d' WHEN age_days < 14 THEN '7-14d' ELSE '>14d' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT service, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-created_at))/86400.0 AS age_days FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed')) t GROUP BY 1,2

panels.title: Change Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of implemented changes that closed successfully (no rollback, no incident within 24h). Target ≥ 95%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(actual_end)

panels.title: Failed Changes
panels.description: Count of failed / rolled-back changes in window. Directly correlates with change-induced incidents.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND status='failed' AND $__timeFilter(actual_end)

panels.title: Emergency Change Rate
panels.description: Emergency changes as % of total changes. High rate (>5%) means CAB process is being bypassed too often.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_type='emergency' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: CAB Approval Rate
panels.description: Share of changes approved by CAB vs total submitted. Low rate signals poor change quality or documentation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cab_status='approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Change Performance (12mo)
panels.description: Monthly successful / failed / emergency changes over 12 months. Trend view of change-management maturity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', actual_end) AS time, CASE WHEN change_type='emergency' THEN 'Emergency' WHEN status='failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN status='successful' THEN 'Successful' ELSE 'Other' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND actual_end >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CAB Decision Distribution
panels.description: Share of CAB decisions (approved / pending / rejected / deferred) in period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cab_status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: High-Risk Changes (Upcoming)
panels.description: Planned changes with risk = High or Critical in next 7 days. Feed for CAB / weekend war-room.

targets.rawSql: SELECT change_id, title, risk, cab_status, planned_start AS window, owner FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND risk IN ('High','Critical') AND planned_start BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY planned_start

panels.title: Active Assets
panels.description: Total CIs currently in Operate lifecycle stage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM assets WHERE env='${env}' AND lifecycle_stage='operate'

panels.title: Critical Assets
panels.description: CIs classified as business-critical (Tier-1). These drive incident and SLA scoring.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM assets WHERE env='${env}' AND criticality='critical'

panels.title: CMDB Coverage %
panels.description: Share of production CIs with valid owner + lifecycle. Target ≥ 95% for a trusted CMDB.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN team IS NOT NULL AND lifecycle_stage IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM assets WHERE env='${env}'

panels.title: EOL Assets (60d)
panels.description: Assets reaching end-of-life in next 60 days. Must be replaced or extended-support contracted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM assets WHERE env='${env}' AND eol_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '60 days'

panels.title: Asset Lifecycle Distribution
panels.description: Plan / Deploy / Operate / Retire / EOL breakdown of the CI estate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lifecycle_stage AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM assets WHERE env='${env}' GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Assets by Ownership Team
panels.description: CI count per owning team. Detects orphaned assets when team is null.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(team,'(orphan)') AS team, COUNT(*) AS assets FROM assets WHERE env='${env}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Operational Risk Heatmap (Service × Category)
panels.description: Latest risk score per service and risk category (Availability, Change, Security, Capacity, SLA, Vendor). Red = act now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service, category, score AS value FROM risk_scores WHERE env='${env}' AND ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM risk_scores)

panels.title: Top 10 Operational Risks
panels.description: Highest-scored open risks. Feeds the Executive Risk Committee agenda.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rank, risk_title, service, score, trend FROM risk_register WHERE env='${env}' AND status='open' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Successful Change Rate
panels.description: % of changes closed as successful in period. Core ITIL v4 change-enablement KPI.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(actual_end)

panels.title: Repeated Incident Rate (Internal)
panels.description: Recurring incidents from internal systems as % of all incidents. Signals unresolved root causes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_recurring AND source='internal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Repeated Incident Rate (3rd Party)
panels.description: Recurring incidents from third-party services. Escalation trigger for vendor governance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_recurring AND source='third_party' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Emergency Change Rate
panels.description: Emergency change share. Target < 5%. Above 10% = process failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_type='emergency' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM changes WHERE env='${env}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: MTTD (Auto vs Manual, min)
panels.description: Mean Time To Detect. Auto = monitoring detection (PRTG/Zabbix). Manual = user-reported. Auto should be < 5 min.

targets.rawSql: SELECT detection_type AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (detected_at - created_at))/60.0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND detected_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: MTTA / MTTR (WH vs NH)
panels.description: Mean Time To Acknowledge (min) and Mean Time To Resolve (h), split Working Hours vs Non-Working Hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'MTTA '||hours_bucket AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_response_at - created_at))/60.0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY hours_bucket

SELECT 'MTTR '||hours_bucket AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE env='${env}' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY hours_bucket

panels.title: Trend Analysis - Core Banking & Card Systems
Core Banking - Incident / Change / SLA / MTTR
panels.description: Daily volumes and quality KPIs for Core Banking family (Accounts, Payments, Ledger).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, 'Incidents' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE service LIKE 'Core Banking%' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', actual_end) AS time, 'Changes' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM changes WHERE service LIKE 'Core Banking%' AND $__timeFilter(actual_end) GROUP BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, 'SLA %' AS metric, compliance_pct AS value FROM sla_metrics WHERE service LIKE 'Core Banking%' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT date_trunc('day', resolved_at) AS time, 'MTTR (h)' AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at-created_at))/3600.0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE service LIKE 'Core Banking%' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Card Systems - Incident / Change / SLA / MTTR
panels.description: Daily volumes and quality KPIs for Card family (Auth Switch, Issuance, ATM).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, 'Incidents' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM incidents WHERE (service LIKE 'Card%' OR service='ATM Network') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', actual_end) AS time, 'Changes' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM changes WHERE (service LIKE 'Card%' OR service='ATM Network') AND $__timeFilter(actual_end) GROUP BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, 'SLA %' AS metric, compliance_pct AS value FROM sla_metrics WHERE (service LIKE 'Card%' OR service='ATM Network') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT date_trunc('day', resolved_at) AS time, 'MTTR (h)' AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at-created_at))/3600.0) AS value FROM incidents WHERE (service LIKE 'Card%' OR service='ATM Network') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Board-Level Insights
panels.description: Auto-generated commentary from rule engine (SLA breach risk, recurring incidents, high-risk assets, CAB priorities).

options.content:
### Key Insights (auto-generated)

- **MTTD (manual) trending up** — +6% MoM in Channels; expand PRTG to Mobile Banking edge nodes.
- **MTTR improved on Core Banking** — -12% QoQ post ledger-reconciliation runbook automation.
- **Card Issuance emergency changes exceed threshold** — 8 in last 30d (target ≤ 3).
- **SLA breach risk – SWIFT Gateway** — 3x P2 open >6h; escalate to Middleware on-call.
- **Recurring incidents – Mobile Banking login** — 14 in 30d; open PRB with App Support.
- **High operational risk – SWIFT MQ SPOF** — prioritize CHG-40244 at next CAB.

### CAB Priorities
1. CHG-40244 - SWIFT MQ HA
2. Card Auth Switch capacity refresh (target 40% headroom)
3. Core Banking Ledger DR test before Q-end
4. TLS cert renewal - Internet Banking (28d)
